title: genesis-os v1.0.7: Self-Reflective OS Framework for GenesisAeon — CREP Orchestrator with Diamond Protocol Sync
description: genesis-os v1.0.7 is the central runtime of the GenesisAeon ecosystem. Version 1.0.2 pins diamond-setup>=2.1.0 (DiamondPackage ABC). Version 1.0.1 synchronised the optional [full-stack] extra to 48 GenesisAeon ecosystem packages on PyPI (correct distribution names, floor pins >=1.0.0). Implements the Unified Lagrangian L = T − V + Φ(H) + Γ(C,R,E,P), UTAC-Logistic ODE, CREP tensor evaluation, and live cosmic-web emergence simulation. Includes AFET+Landauer thermodynamic consistency, Mirror Machine, Sigillin semantic anchors, FraktalRun phase-space engine, SDE/Stochastic UTAC, and OPA-based ethics governance. Python 3.10+, 91% test coverage, Dash web GUI.
